job.question: What evaluation criteria and percentage weights does the Texas Municipal Retirement System (TMRS) global custody RFP use to evaluate respondents?
job.expected_facts: 1. Scope Affirmation, Servicing Approach, and Institutional Credentials - 25%; 2. Core and Value Added Services and Technology Platforms - 40%; 3. Quality of Response and Additional Evidence of Capability - 10%; 4. Competitiveness & Reasonableness of Economics - 25%.
job.acceptance: Accept faithful shorter criterion names with correct mapping 25/40/10/25. Supporting subcriteria are optional.

reviews.reason: This is an Indiana Public Retirement System audit-services RFP, not the Texas Municipal Retirement System global custody RFP. Its evaluation criteria are unweighted and do not provide the requested four criteria or their percentage weights.
quotes: Request for Proposals (“RFP”) for Audit Services for the Indiana Public Retirement System (“INPRS” or the “System”)
INPRS is issuing this RFP in accordance with Indiana statutes governing the procurement of services and certain administrative policies of INPRS.
Specific criteria include: 1. Fulfilling the requirements set forth in the RFP 2. Technical knowledge, skills, and other competencies 3. Respondent qualifications
